description:
Extract structured, schema-conforming JSON from the knowledge base.

Runs the KS agent in extraction mode: it retrieves the relevant chunks
and returns an object matching your JSON Schema, so you get typed
fields instead of prose to re-parse. Use this for populating records,
filling forms, or building tables; use ``ask`` when you want a written
answer with citations.

Exactly one of ``output_schema`` / ``schema_path_part_id`` is required.
The call blocks until the agent finishes and consumes one message of
tenant quota.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema (as an object) describing the shape to return. Provide this OR `schema_path_part_id`, not both.
output_schema.title: Output Schema

prompt.description: What to pull out of the knowledge base, in plain language — e.g. 'the payment terms and renewal date from the Acme MSA'.
prompt.title: Prompt

schema_path_part_id.description: path_part_id of a KS document whose body *is* a JSON Schema — use this to reuse a schema your tenant already stores. Provide this OR `output_schema`, not both.
schema_path_part_id.title: Schema Path Part Id

timeout_s.description: How long to wait for the agent to finish (seconds).
timeout_s.title: Timeout S

name: extract

structured.description: The extracted object. Conforms to the JSON Schema passed as `output_schema` (or stored at `schema_path_part_id`).
structured.title: Structured
